div.span:
1 C5-CSI帧解析
magic 0xC511 to node_id A phi RSSI

2 SignalPipeline.process
PhaseSanitize to Normalizer to Hampel
to Motion to CoherenceGate

3 extract_features
帧间差0.4+方差0.2+频带功率0.25+变化点0.15

4 动态采样率
dt to EMA alpha=0.15 to f_s

7 FieldBridge.feed
SVD校准 to 扰动能量 to 信号场热力图

8 CIRBridge.process
ISTA L1稀疏恢复 to ToF测距

5 运动分类 4级
motion_score to EMA to 阈值判决

6 VitalsBridge.extract
IIR带通 to 零交叉 BR + 自相关 HR

9 混合定位
子载波方差60% + 相位多普勒40%
to 平方权重质心

10 TriageEngine.process
cos匹配 to START五级分诊 to 恶化检测

11 EdgeModuleEngine x10
10模块并行 to Vec EdgeAlert

SensingUpdate JSON
to broadcast channel to WebSocket /ws/sensing
